name: remotion-three-video-skill
description: Configuration-driven Remotion template for polished Three.js videos.

scripts.still: npm run ensure-audio && remotion still VideoTemplate out/frame-300.png --frame=300 --scale=0.25 --gl=angle
scripts.build: npm run ensure-audio && remotion render VideoTemplate out/video.mp4 --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p --gl=angle && npm run copy-desktop
